title: Why Your Hand Pulls Away Before You Feel Pain
hook: Your body reacts to heat faster than your brain can feel it.

narration.text: Your hand pulls away from a hot surface before you even register pain.
This is due to a protective mechanism called a reflex arc.
Sensory nerves detect heat and send a signal directly to your spinal cord.
The spinal cord instantly sends a command back to your muscles to withdraw.
Only after this action does the signal travel up to your brain for pain perception.
This rapid, automatic response prevents serious burns.
Like this video if you found this body trick surprising, and subscribe for more insights into how your mind and body work.

description: Ever wondered why you flinch away from something hot before you even feel the burning sensation? It's all thanks to a fascinating reflex arc built into your nervous system. This short explains the incredible speed of your body's protective responses.
topic: Why you instinctively pull your hand away from a hot surface before you even feel pain. This is a built-in reflex.
